desc: Prove the formula for the minimum number of increments needed to make any fixed subarray non-decreasing.
Design an `O(n)` reverse sliding-window monotonic-deque algorithm with exact prepend and right-removal cost updates.
Verify the implementation on both provided examples and edge cases: already sorted arrays, strictly decreasing arrays, equal elements, and very large values.
Produce the final Python solution in the required `Solution.countNonDecreasingSubarrays` format with complexity analysis.
